text:
Lena: Quick follow-up from today
Omar: Customer (NordicPay) needs SOC2 exec summary, ISO27001 cert, signed pen-test attestation, and an EU-region presigned upload URL valid 72h. They specifically said no raw scanner outputs. @Priya @Matt
Priya: Noted. We usually supply SOC2 exec summary PDF and ISO cert PDF. Pen-test: we can provide a signed attestation summarizing scope and remediation; raw report redacted.
Matt: I can sign as Ops Lead. Legal will need to approve the exact wording. We should include scope (prod+staging), timeframe (last 12 months), and remediation confirmation.
legal-bot: Uploaded pen-test-letter-template-v3.docx to /internal/legal/pen-test-templates
Lena: Customer wants upload path /nordicpay/poc/evidence/erik-lind.zip, max 1GB. Also asked if we can notarize the pen-test letter (nice-to-have).
ops-bot: Please create ticket OPS-7241 with region=eu-west-1, presign PUT, path=/nordicpay/poc/evidence/erik-lind.zip, expiry=72h, max_size=1GB
Omar: Can we confirm redaction policy?
Priya: Redaction: exec summary + remediation attestation + affected CVE IDs may be redacted on request. Full logs only under NDA and secured transfer.
Matt: Agree. I'll draft the signed attestation and route to legal. ETA today EOD.
Lena: I'll confirm with Erik (erik.lind@nordicpay.com) whether corporate stamp/notarization required and report back.
Omar: Heads-up: if they ask for Dedicated/on-prem POC for residency that changes pricing and timelines. AE should be looped.
Lena: I'll spawn a separate thread for Dedicated pricing. This one stays evidence + presign.
Priya: Once legal approves, ops will post presigned URL here. Please remind NordicPay to upload within 72h.
Matt: Will attach signed PDF here when ready.
Lena: Thanks all. Closing when signed letter + presign + certs posted. :white_check_mark:
